source:
@@U03762@@
Go, now.
Pile up treasure on treasure!
Create a display so exalted
it has never been seen!
Let our vaulted halls glisten
like skies new-fashioned!
Make paradises out of lifeless life!
Roll out soft flowered carpets for her to tread on.
Let her see splendor
that would dazzle all but the gods!

@@U03764@@
Your orders, sir, are child’s play to me.
Little sooner said than done.
This supreme beauty makes all things her servants.
Our army’s already tamed,
every sword blunt and lamed,
and the sun itself is cold and dull
compared with her radiant beauty.
So grand a vision turns all things empty and base.

@@U03766@@
(To 浮士德.)

@@U03767@@
I wish to speak to you,
but come and sit beside me.
This empty seat calls for its master
who safeguards mine.

@@U03769@@
First let me kneel, noble lady,
and pledge you my heart!
Then kiss the hand that raises me to your side!
Confirm me now as coregent of your realm
that knows no bounds,
and allow me to be to you,
all in one,
admirer, servant, and guardian.

@@U03771@@
e
I’ve seen and heard so many wonders,
translation:
@@U03762@@
走吧，现在。
财宝堆积如山！
创造如此尊贵的展示
从来没有见过！
让我们的拱形大厅闪闪发光
就像新式的天空！
把毫无生气的生命变成天堂！
铺上柔软的花地毯让她踩在上面。
让她看到辉煌
那会让除了众神以外的所有人都眼花缭乱！

@@U03764@@
先生，您的命令对我来说简直就是小孩子的游戏。
说起来比做起来快。
这种至高无上的美丽使万物成为她的仆人。
我们的军队已经驯服了，
每把剑都变得钝而有缺陷，
太阳本身又冷又暗
与她容光焕发的美丽相比。
如此宏伟的愿景使一切变得空虚和卑鄙。

@@U03766@@
（致浮士德。）

@@U03767@@
我想和你说话，
但请过来坐在我旁边。
这个空位子呼唤主人
谁来保护我的。

@@U03769@@
首先让我跪下，高贵的女士，
并向你保证我的心！
然后亲吻那只把我举到你身边的手！
现在确认我作为你们王国的共同统治者
没有界限，
并允许我对你来说，
合而为一，
崇拜者、仆人和监护人。

@@U03771@@
